# Write PRD

Summarize the design concept reached during the current grilling session into a
single active PRD saved at `prd/PRD.md`.

If `prd/PRD.md` already exists, replace it completely with the new active PRD.
Do not append to it, preserve old sections, or merge older plan content into the
new PRD.

Include:
- Problem Statement
- Proposed Solution
- User Stories (Definition of Done)
- Implementation Decisions
- Testing Strategy
- Rollout & Feature Flags — for a feature delivered across multiple plans, state which
  slice this is (e.g. "slice 2 of 3") and name the feature flag that keeps the work dark
  until the whole feature lands; omit only when the plan ships complete on its own
- Out of Scope (to prevent scope creep)

Keep each PRD to a single shippable slice. If the design covers several independently
shippable capabilities, write the PRD for the FIRST slice only and list the rest under
Out of Scope as later plans — an over-scoped plan is rejected before it is built.

Definition of Done items must be **repo-observable**: behavior, files, tests, or
docs a reviewer can verify from the repository itself. Process expectations —
"the PR description explains X", review sign-offs, deployment steps, demo
walkthroughs — are not DoD items; if the plan needs them, put them under a
separate "Hand-off notes" heading so decomposition never turns them into issue
acceptance criteria that no per-issue QA round can verify.

## Next step — ask how this plan will run

After saving the PRD (and having it reviewed with `qa-review-plan`), ask the user
which way to run it — do not pick silently:

- **Local** — continue in this session: break the plan into issues
  (`prd-to-issues`), then run `./ralph.sh`.
- **Remote (hand off to GitHub Actions)** — do NOT run `prd-to-issues`; the remote
  run decomposes the plan itself. If not already on a `ralph/...` branch, run
  `./ralph-handoff.sh <slug>` — it creates `ralph/<slug>`, commits the plan, and
  pushes (the push starts the run). If already on a `ralph/...` branch, commit
  `prd/PRD.md` (plus any doc updates) and push to that branch instead.
